content:
maya: Quick RFC follow-up: untangle regional/locality logic so router and policy DSL aren't both changing for minor tweaks.
devon: Current pain: region bias in router, cost/latency heuristics in DSL. deploy blast radius too big.
ron: Telemetry emissions are fragmented which breaks attribution.
maya: Proposal: extract a tiny LocalityScorer interface (pure function). runtime calls scorer(request_features, telemetry_snapshot, constraints) -> ordered list of (route_id, score, hints). scorer implementations pluggable via feature-flag.
priya: Tenant overrides? prefer dedicated GPUs or pin to region? post-filter or input?
devon: Keep tenant constraints in input so scorer only returns compatible routes; router still enforces admission. deterministic, easier tests.
ron: Add helper is_compatible(route_meta, constraints) -> bool. Clear contract.
maya: Interface sketch: score(request_features, telemetry_snapshot, constraints) -> [(route,score,hints)] and is_compatible(route_meta,constraints) -> bool. Keep language-agnostic (wasm possible).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary for scorer.v2 tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC.
priya: Rollout: feature-flag by tenant. Migration: compile DSL region_penalty/cost_cap -> scorer-config via translator in policy-compiler.
devon: Example translator output (as a string config produced by compiler).
maya: Telemetry/explainability: scorer should return small hints (e.g. "low_cost","probe_fresh") to surface in Console. keep vocabulary constrained.
priya: Perf: fast path budget <200us. If heavy, use progressive scoring: cheap pass then optional hedging pass for close calls. tenant-configurable threshold.
devon: Progressive design: fast proxies (cached p95, cached cost) then slow hedging only when delta < threshold.
maya: Warm pool interaction: add "warmth" to telemetry_snapshot (warm_pool_size). scorer can penalize cold routes; router may prewarm if worth it.
ron: Fail-safes: on scorer timeout/crash, fall back to legacy routing. metrics: scorer.latency_ms, scorer.timeout, scorer.fallback_used.
priya: Tests: integration DSL->scorer-config->scorer equality checks for seeded cases; load test p99 <200us.
maya: Plan steps: 1) RFC follow-up spec for LocalityScorer + compat API, 2) translator in policy-compiler, 3) pluggable scorer in router (wasm shim), 4) telemetry/explainability contract, 5) canary rollout behind tenant flag. tagging @devon @priya @ron for review. Thanks! :thumbsup:
